I think our instructor was very successful on raising discussion questions that would last for a whole class. She always made sure everyone participated, she valued everyone's thoughts. She taught us what questions to ask while analyzing a play and stimulated interest by providing us interesting facts about the era and the writers as well as reviews of the plays.
The only thing I want to mention that can be regarded as negative is the break times. I think if we have been more punctual on returning from the break, we would have even more time to have our amazing discussions!
